snippet.title: GTA 6 Is FINALLY Out... And Players Already Found BIGFOOT?! (Launch Day Chaos)
snippet.description:
13 years later... GTA 6 is FINALLY here. 🌴 Grand Theft Auto VI is out worldwide on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S after a rolling midnight launch, and within 24 hours players already found a cat that attacks Jason, a Bigfoot-like creature in Leonida's swamps, and a UFO. We break down the launch, the 99 Metacritic reviews, Rockstar's Miami Heat takeover and drone show, the 30 FPS and GTA+ pushback, and the wildest launch-day clips. 👀

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 GTA 6 is finally out worldwide
0:35 The rolling midnight launch + 17M est. pre-orders
1:16 The reviews: 99 on Metacritic and OpenCritic
1:47 Rockstar went all out: Miami Heat, drone show, new artworks
2:21 The bad news: 30 FPS confirmed
2:38 GTA+ perks in story mode + Ultimate Edition bonuses
3:02 Launch-day chaos: angry cat, Bigfoot, UFO, Furverts
3:27 Road-rage NPCs, dump-truck physics, the swingset glitch
3:45 Relationships, the "before GTA 6" meme
4:07 Streamers + the Atlanta Police
4:32 Outro

📊 Key facts
• GTA VI rolled out at midnight local time across 15 launch windows, starting in New Zealand (11:00 UTC Nov 18) and ending with Mexico & Central America (06:00 UTC Nov 19), on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, about 13 years after GTA V (per iGrandTheftAuto / GTA 6 Countdown)
• Sensor Tower estimated about 17.07 million pre-orders and about $1.65 billion in revenue as it launched in New Zealand (estimates, not official numbers)
• Reviews: 99 Metascore from about 150 PS5 critic reviews and a 99 OpenCritic Top Critic Average (as of Nov 19). It ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Metacritic's highest score. IGN, GameSpot and GamesRadar+ gave it 100; The New York Times gave it 90
• Rockstar x Miami Heat: "A Night in Vice City" (Heat vs Bucks on a Vice City court in new uniforms), a live-action "Welcome to Vice City" trailer filmed in Miami, and a drone show over Miami with the logo, Jason and Lucia
• 8 new artworks, some as PS5 Welcome Hub backgrounds; Overmono revealed as additional composers alongside Justice; the GTAVI: The Album tracklist is on Spotify and Apple Music (album releases Nov 20)
• Rockstar confirmed 30 FPS on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S. Early performance tests say base PS5 can dip into the mid-20s
• GTA+ members get story-mode perks: the '90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy widebody, a Crosstown garage with a weapon locker, 10% discounts at select businesses, and free rentals and transit. The car and garage are claimable in Chapter 3 only while subscribed. Reddit users called it "unacceptable" (Polygon, GAMINGbible)
• Ultimate Edition bonuses unlock gradually as you progress through the story
• Launch-day finds: a cat that attacks Jason when you hijack its car; a Bigfoot-like creature in the swamps; a UFO sighting; a "Furverts" random encounter; NPC road rage; dump-truck rocks with individual ragdoll physics; the GTA IV swingset glitch is back; sprint moved to L3; paid hookups removed, but Jason and Lucia have relationship scenes; an in-game post parodying the "before GTA 6" meme
• xQc renovated Jason's house on stream. Atlanta Police (via CBS News Atlanta): "Play the game, but don't play yourself and end up in jail."

Sources: iGrandTheftAuto, GTA 6 Countdown (@GTAVI_Countdown), GTA 6 Intel (@GTAlphaintel), Rockstar Games, Sensor Tower, Metacritic, OpenCritic, Digital Trends, Endgame Tools, Polygon, GAMINGbible, Shacknews, IGN, CBS News Atlanta (Nov 18-19, 2026)
Footage: Rockstar Games (GTA VI Trailers 1 & 2, Launch Trailer, An Extended Look, new artworks and screenshots), Rockstar Games x Miami Heat (Welcome to Vice City trailer, A Night in Vice City, Miami drone show). Gameplay clips credited on screen: @GTAlphaintel, @GTAVI_Countdown, @DenceCabbage & @ChumBucketDrama, @jasontheween via @getawayvice, ActiveRagdollExperiments (YouTube), @TypicalGamer, @JakeSucky, xQc. snippet.title: GTA 6 Told xQc It's Not Bigfoot. It's a 'Skunk Ape.' 🦍
snippet.description:
GTA 5 let you hunt Bigfoot. In GTA 6, a character tells xQc's player character it was never Bigfoot.

Top: GTA 5 Bigfoot footage. Bottom: xQc's GTA 6 playthrough. This clip shows the conversation only, not the creature.
